name: City Council Notice of Adjourned Regular Meeting for March 16, 2026

  CITY OF EL MONTE
  CITY COUNCIL
  NOTICE OF ADJOURNED
  REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTIONS 54955
  AND 54955.1

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the El Monte City Council has adjourned
  its Regular City Council Meeting of Wednesday, March 11, 2026 to an
  Adjourned Regular City Council meeting on Monday, March 16, 2026 p.m.
  at 5:00 p.m. and to an Adjourned Regular City Council meeting on
  Wednesday, March 18, 2026 at 6:00 p.m. to take place at El Monte City
  Hall East – City Council Chambers, 11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte,
  CA 91731.
  All public hearings that may have been noticed for the Regular City
  Council Meeting of Wednesday, March 11, 2026 are also continued to the
  Adjourned Regular Meeting of Monday, March 16, 2026 and to the
  Adjourned Regular Meeting of Wednesday, March 18, 2026 per
  Government Code Section 54955.1.

  POSTED AT 5:55 p.m. on March 12, 2026
  by Griselda Contreras, City Clerk Services Manager

  “The Friendly City of El Monte”
